ITEM 1 | About 17 small oval nut-like pieces, tan-brown with smooth slightly matte skins, pointed at one end, each roughly 2.5 to 3 cm long and 1.5 to 2 cm wide, clustered in a loose heap in the center of a square pale blue-white plate covering about 20% of the plate's area, dry with no sheen or moisture, firm and holding shape, some pieces partially stacked on others | 60

ITEM 2 | A single thin orange-colored sliver, about 1 cm long, smooth and slightly glossy, lying on the upper right of the plate near a faint pinkish smear, dry and firm | 0.5

ITEM 3 | A tiny pale yellow fleck, under 0.5 cm, sitting at the lower right edge of the plate, dry and crumb-like | 0.2
